visual_metadata.visual_description: A witch costume on a rounded cream fuzzy plush character with glossy black round eyes, a small curved smile, and pink blush cheeks: a tall dark purple pointed hat with a gold buckle, a long dark purple robe with a cape, holding a broom.

A jack-o'-lantern costume on a rounded cream fuzzy plush character with glossy black round eyes, a small curved smile, and pink blush cheeks: a carved orange pumpkin worn as a hood with the face showing through the front, and a puffy ribbed orange pumpkin suit with a green leaf collar.

A ghost costume: a cream fuzzy plush character covered head to feet by a crinkled white sheet, with glossy black round eyes and pink blush showing through two eye holes; its mouth is hidden, and its paws and feet peek out below.

A skeleton costume on a rounded cream fuzzy plush character with glossy black round eyes, a small curved smile, and pink blush cheeks: a plush bone-white cartoon skull worn as a hood with the face showing through the front, and a black bodysuit printed with white bones.

A werewolf costume on a rounded cream fuzzy plush character with glossy black round eyes, a small curved smile, and pink blush cheeks: a shaggy brown fur suit with pointed wolf ears, clawed paws, and a bushy tail.
A friendly zombie costume on a rounded plush character with glossy black round eyes, a small curved smile, and pale green face makeup: a hood and outfit of tattered, patched sage-green rags.

A Grim Reaper costume on a rounded cream fuzzy plush character with glossy black round eyes, a small curved smile, and pink blush cheeks: a hooded black robe with a ragged hem, holding a small cartoon scythe.

A devil costume on a rounded cream fuzzy plush character with glossy black round eyes, a small curved smile, and pink blush cheeks: a red hooded suit with small red horns, a short red cape, and a long red pointed tail.

A Halloween clown costume on a rounded cream fuzzy plush character with glossy black round eyes, a small curved smile, and pink blush cheeks: a curly rainbow clown wig, a round red foam nose, a white ruffled collar trimmed in red, yellow, and blue, a puffy half-red, half-yellow polka-dot jumpsuit with red, yellow, and blue pom-pom buttons, and yellow polka-dot clown shoes.

A mummy costume on a rounded cream fuzzy plush character with glossy black round eyes, a small curved smile, and pink blush cheeks: cream bandage strips wrapped around its whole body and head, leaving the face showing, with a few loose ends.
